items.stem: Why review the output of terraform plan before running apply?

options.text: Plan shows exactly what will be created, changed or destroyed before it happens
options.rationale: Correct: reviewing the plan catches unintended or destructive changes first.

options.text: Apply cannot change anything, so review is optional
options.rationale: Apply makes real changes; that is why plan review matters.
Plan does not approve; a human still decides.

items.explanation: Correct: reviewing the plan catches unintended or destructive changes first.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices make a production infrastructure change safer? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Require a human approval after a reviewed plan
options.rationale: Correct: human approval on a reviewed plan is a deliberate gate.

options.text: Document a rollback path before applying
options.rationale: Correct: a rollback plan limits damage if the change fails.

options.text: Apply directly from AI output without review
options.rationale: Unreviewed apply can make unintended changes.

options.text: Use administrator credentials for every change
options.rationale: Over-broad credentials widen the blast radius.

items.explanation: Correct: human approval on a reviewed plan is a deliberate gate.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A change touches one S3 bucket. What IAM scope follows least privilege?

options.text: Permissions limited to that bucket and the required actions
options.rationale: Correct: least privilege grants only what the change needs.
Administrator access far exceeds what the change needs.

options.text: No permissions, relying on the console UI
options.rationale: The change still needs scoped permissions to run.

options.text: Permissions to all buckets in the account
options.rationale: Account-wide access is broader than the change requires.

items.explanation: Correct: least privilege grants only what the change needs.
